about: Read from the Candle CLI's source by scripts/read-cli-source.ts, as text, never imported or run: the dispatch table, each handler's own parseArgs flags (and flags it lifts out before the parse, as value flags), --json, its identity from what it calls, whether it unlocks the vault and which streams it needs to be a terminal (following its calls into other files), and the access presets' scopes.

rows.description: List live main-perp markets directly from Hyperliquid; any Candle agent key required
Market detail, margin tiers, impact prices and precision rules
Live order book, spread and mid, directly from Hyperliquid
OHLCV candles (default 1h, 100); oldest first, directly from Hyperliquid

Move funds onto the Hyperliquid account through Relay, from the key's Solana or Hood TEE wallet (swap:write); only configured raw caps and USD limits apply (unset means unlimited, zero still binds); --no-submit is a dry run that holds no wallet and uses no limit; status reads one

After the first deposit has landed, approve Candle's builder fee once; shows the account's mode and balance. Refused, with nothing signed, while the account has never received a deposit or unless Hyperliquid shows it in standard mode
Market (IOC) without --price, limit with it; optional --tp and --sl
Reduce-only IOC close of all or part of a position; --pct closes a percentage (at most 4 decimals), rounded down to the market's size step, and a result of zero is refused, never rounded up
Cancel an order Candle built, by its cloid
Change a resting order Candle built; side, time in force and reduce-only are kept from Hyperliquid's record. A trigger leg is not modified (use tpsl)
Add isolated margin (positive only), or set the coin's margin mode keeping its leverage unless --leverage names one; a mode change needs no position and no resting order in the coin
Attach, change or remove position take-profit / stop-loss legs, sized to the position now. A change cancels the old leg first (a protection gap). Legs Candle did not build are listed and left alone
Set (at least 5 s ahead) or clear Hyperliquid's cancel-all timer. Wallet-wide: it cancels every open order, protection included, not positions; 10 triggers per UTC day, not counted by Candle
Cancel every open main-perp order, then close every main-perp position, then read again; at most 100 signed steps a run. Spot, HIP-3 and vaults are not reached
Read or set the key's reduce-only restriction. This key may turn itself on; off, or another key, needs the owner's device token. Limits new Candle builds only
Open orders on Hyperliquid, and every action Candle built

Move USDC from the Hyperliquid account to this key's own Solana or Hood TEE wallet through Relay (perps:withdraw); at least 10 USDC, with Relay's fees at most 5% (Hyperliquid's one-time 1 USDC activation fee on a first withdrawal not counted); one vault unlock and a typed confirm, no --yes
Positions, account value and withdrawable USDC, read live, and any withdrawal in flight

One page of the wallet's fills, read directly from Hyperliquid (any read-capable key; no signer). Default: the last 7 days, 100 rows. Closed P&L is gross and the fee already includes the builder fee. Hyperliquid keeps only the 10,000 most recent fills
One page of the wallet's funding payments, signed (paid or received), read directly from Hyperliquid; at most 500 rows a page
Set a market's leverage and margin mode
Account value, margin used, free margin, withdrawable, margin ratio, and realized P&L, fees and funding over a window (default 24h, at most 30 days)
The level now (ok, warn, critical) with what drives it; exit 0, 10 or 11, and 1 when unknown
Poll from this machine and print one JSON line per level change, heartbeat or error; runs until stopped and exits with the last level's code
Show this key's risk thresholds; set or clear them. As self (the default) a key may only tighten; a prefix or label uses the device token and may loosen

keys.summary: API keys, and the wallets each key may use

rows.description: List live API keys: name and Read, Write or Withdraw access; --all includes revoked keys; --scopes adds the raw scopes

Create an API key; --no-store prints it without saving it as the profile's working key (default: store only if no working key exists). --access mints one of the levels (write trades and launches; only withdraw can move funds; trade-perps is exactly account:read and perps:write, for Hyperliquid perps setup and orders, and it cannot fund its own Hyperliquid account: a Relay deposit needs swap:write and a withdrawal needs perps:withdraw, each a separate grant through --scopes). A trade-perps key trades from an EVM TEE wallet promoted onto it (candle vault new-key --chain evm, then candle vault promote --from <cold> --to-key <prefix>; candle tee new is Solana only) and a signer on the trading machine (candle tee signer new --key <prefix>). --embedded-wallet defaults to deny; allow lets the key spend the account's embedded wallet and is confirmed at a terminal

Change an existing key's level in place (same key, wallets and caps). Widening needs the device token and the prefix typed back at a terminal; --yes skips the prompt when narrowing; self narrows the profile's own key. --history lists the key's changes and who made them
Allow or deny a key the account's embedded wallet, with the device token. Allowing needs the prefix typed back at a terminal; --yes skips the prompt when denying
Set or clear the USD transaction cap on an existing key, with the device token. --reset defaults to daily

Set a key's per-asset caps (sol, usdc, cndl, eth, usdg; a whole number of base units per transaction) with the profile's own API key. It can only lower a cap or add one; raising or removing one is refused (LOOSEN_REQUIRES_SESSION) and is the owner's, in the web key manager. The list replaces the key's caps
The profile's own key gives up the embedded wallet, with no prompt. A key can never allow itself: the owner does that with keys update
Pause one key with the device token; reversible with keys resume
Resume a stopped key with the device token

Give a key a new secret, keeping its prefix, label, access, limits, wallets and history. The old secret works through --grace (default 1h, at most 24h) or stops at once with --now; --finish ends an open window early. The profile's own key is replaced in the keychain; update CANDLE_API_KEY and other copies yourself. --force rotates again while a window is open
Revoke an API key permanently
Approve (or reject) a key's signer request with the device token; type the full fingerprint the trading machine printed

On the machine holding a wallet's current signer: move every wallet on the key onto its active signer (legacy per-wallet ones too). --to-key moves a revoked key's wallets to a live key (device token). Resumable
Wallets an agent profile can use. TEE wallets move between keys with candle tee rebind
Replace the profile's wallet set; from a key it can only narrow. To move TEE wallets to a key: candle tee rebind
Limit a profile to assigned wallets

wallets.summary: Launch and linked wallets; import or revoke one (wallets is an alias)

rows.description: Import a wallet you own (key via --key-file or hidden prompt). A fresh key, without solana-keygen: candle vault new-key --chain solana, candle vault export-key <label> --to <file>, import that file, then delete the file
Give agents access to the account's embedded wallets: opens the Agents page's grant step in your browser (no key is created) and, with an API key, waits until it lands
Revoke a linked wallet

The account's withdrawal allowlist (the destinations candle transfer --to <label> resolves by). Any key reads it; approving an address is the owner's, in the agent console's Wallets tab (an API key cannot approve); an acting key can revoke one, a read-only key cannot. --all adds removed rows
Mark linked wallets yours, so agents can move funds into them (owner only; typed confirm)
Clear the mark; moving funds in needs the withdrawal allowlist again (owner only)

Deprecated: a key's launch:write decides TEE launches where the server has TEE_LAUNCH_BY_SCOPE_ENABLED on. Otherwise lets TEE wallets pay for a launch (candle launch), after a screen of label, address and bound key (owner only; typed confirm)

Deprecated: where the server has TEE_LAUNCH_BY_SCOPE_ENABLED on it saves the value but cannot stop a launch, and exits 1 with the server's message; pause the key (candle keys stop) instead. Otherwise stops TEE wallets paying for a launch; trading is unchanged (owner only)

Close a wallet's empty token accounts and return their rent to it, after a preview: the embedded wallet (transfer:write), or a TEE wallet bound to this key, signed by its key signer (swap:write). --preview prints what would close (one JSON document on stdout under --json) and closes nothing

Create a profile before authenticating it
Make a profile the active one

This profile's Solana RPC, used when --rpc-url and CANDLE_SOLANA_RPC_URL are not given. Stored in config.json; only its host is ever shown

vault.summary: Your vault: factors, keys, backup, restore, transfer, promote

rows.description: Create the vault: one passphrase factor and an HD root
What the vault holds, and what opens it

One line per key: address, label, role, TEE lifecycle, derivation. Retired TEE wallets are hidden unless --all. Prompts for the passphrase. --balances reads SOL over your Solana RPC and ETH (plus USDG on Hood) for EVM keys over --evm-rpc-url, CANDLE_EVM_RPC_URL, or the built-in Hood RPC
Derive the next Solana key (m/44'/501'/n'/0') or EVM key (m/44'/60'/n'/0/0), or n of them under one unlock; the name must be free
Rename one vault or external key, or a retired TEE wallet. New names: at most 64 characters, no edge whitespace. The address, the derivation and the key blob do not change

Rename 1–256 vault or external keys (or retired TEE wallets) under one unlock and one commit. All findings refuse the whole file; swaps are allowed. --dry-run prints the plan and writes nothing; --json returns the renamed rows
Show the 24-word recovery phrase (terminal only)

Rebuild a vault from the recovery phrase; it gets a new passphrase. --evm-count derives EVM indices 0..m-1 and --evm-tee-count Hood TEE wallets 0..k-1 on m/44'/60'/n'/1'/0' (default 0, never gap-scanned; the sealed EVM record does not come back, so a sweep then needs --from-block or --token). A gap scan needs --rpc-url on this command; no default or stored endpoint is used for it
Re-read this account and add exposure; clears nothing
Manage the factors that open the vault: …. --install-helper (security-key) fetches and verifies this release's candle-fido2 first
Same as factor add: …

Copy the vault and verify the copy in full; icloud is iCloud Drive; sealed copies carry the passphrase and security keys. A vault with Hood TEE wallets also writes its sealed EVM record beside the copy (<copy minus .enc>.evm-record.sealed), the lines that decrypt only
Verify a copy in full (all eight steps; a ninth for a vault with Hood TEE wallets: every line of the record beside the copy decrypts under the copy's key)
Migrate tee-wallets.enc into the vault
Rename the Phase 1 store after a verified backup

Sign a transfer locally from a vault key or a promoted TEE wallet (Solana, or Hood: refused while a sequenced trade holds the wallet's nonce, and when that cannot be read). From an EVM key: ETH or an ERC-20, on Hood by default (--rpc-url for any EVM chain; the chain id is read from the RPC), exit 0 means depth-confirmed (1 block on Hood, 2 elsewhere), not finalized. A Solana key reads and sends over --rpc-url, else CANDLE_SOLANA_RPC_URL, else the profile's RPC, else the public endpoint. Max sends SOL minus the quoted fee (zero source reserve when emptied), or the whole token balance; EVM native max deducts the fee cap. SOL max refreshes before signing; a changed amount or fee requires a fresh confirm. One verification: the unlock names the send; after the decoded display you type confirm. No --yes

Fresh TEE key, or promote one vault key in place. Reads, over your RPC, whether each key is a token mint, freeze, program upgrade or stake authority (9 requests per key; public endpoints refuse the token scans). Multisig membership is not checked. An EVM key becomes a Hood TEE wallet (--from derives m/44'/60'/n'/1'/0'; --sweep-to is a cold EVM vault key; --rpc-url is the Hood RPC); the vault becomes version 4 and records the promote height as the wallet's scan start.

Promote many vault keys in place: one unlock, one reviewed acknowledgement. Reads, over your RPC, whether each key is a token mint, freeze, program upgrade or stake authority (9 requests per key; public endpoints refuse the token scans). Multisig membership is not checked. A file of EVM keys promotes them to Hood TEE wallets (ETH shown, no authority read); one file is one chain.

Fund a TEE or external wallet from a vault key. A Hood TEE wallet takes ETH or USDG from its pinned EVM vault key. One verification: the unlock names the send; after the decoded display you type confirm. No --yes

Disable then sweep a TEE wallet back to its pin. A Hood wallet takes tee sweep's --token and --from-block (one wallet only). Several addresses, or --all --empty, demote one at a time under one unlock: every wallet and its sweep destination is listed, then you type confirm once (--yes skips it; it stands in for each sweep's confirm). A failure does not stop the rest; each wallet gets a result line and a summary counts done, incomplete, failed and skipped with reasons. --json writes one document: wallets[] and summary
Export one key as plaintext (interactive ceremony: unlock, then type confirm under the address)

tee.summary: Dedicated TEE wallet keys for agents: seal, delegate, fund, sweep

rows.description: Add a Solana key to an existing tee-wallets.enc. With no store, refuses: candle vault new-key --chain solana, then candle vault promote --from <label> --to-key <prefix>. --factor does not apply
Delegate a TEE wallet key; pin the sweep vault (--vault-key <label> also)
Print the funding instruction for your vault to sign
Server lifecycle state and on-chain balances without unlocking; --verify opens the vault and checks the key. On Hood, ETH, USDG, the gas reserve and gas: low
Stop the agent; verified stop or pending, never "done" on a 200

Sign locally and move everything to the pinned vault; closes DAMM v2 LP positions after verifying each server-built close (--emergency moves the position NFT instead, with no API). A Hood wallet (0x): USDG, WETH, the sealed EVM record, the server's list (not under --emergency), every --token, and Transfer logs from its recorded scan start or --from-block, then ETH last; it refuses while a sequenced trade holds the wallet's nonce
Move TEE wallets to another key on this account, which is how a key gets TEE wallets. Name them, or --label-prefix for every wallet whose label starts with it (owner only; funds do not move)
List TEE wallet rebinds for this account (owner only)

Rename one TEE wallet: the label Candle holds and, when its key is in this vault, the vault entry (owner only). New names: at most 64 characters, no edge whitespace. Funds, the address and the key do not change. A retired (demoted) TEE wallet is no longer on Candle: rename it with vault rename

Rename 1–256 TEE wallets with one server call, all or nothing, then one vault commit. Every finding refuses the whole file. The vault is unlocked once, only when a named TEE wallet may be in it. --dry-run prints the plan and changes nothing; if the vault write fails after the server accepted, it prints address-keyed rows to re-run

On the trading machine, with that key's API key: generate the key's signer here and wait for the owner to approve it. Its wallets then trade from this machine. --out also writes a plaintext P-256 authorization key for Privy wallet RPC; it cannot sign Solana transactions (the TEE signs them). --no-wait exits 0 once pending. --json emits newline-delimited JSON: a pending event with userCode, verificationUriComplete, expiresAt and fingerprint immediately, then an active result or error if waiting. Retrying re-attaches to the same live request;  --force adds a signer while an older signer on THIS machine still owns wallets; it moves, revokes and deletes nothing
Read the server signer state once without generating a pair or requesting approval. --json prints one value; on the requesting machine it includes the cached code and URL while that request is live
Remove this machine's key signer once it owns no wallets, and tell the server it is gone. Refuses while a wallet is still owned by it. The device token, or the key's own API key
